officials.bio: Joel Hondorp served as Byron Township Clerk from 2000-2018, earning the 2010 Michigan Association of Municipal Clerks Township Clerk of the Year award. He holds a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science from Michigan State University and achieved Master Municipal Clerk status in 2019.

officials.name: Max Frantz
officials.address: 300 Monroe Avenue NW Grand Rapids, Michigan 49503
officials.bio: Max Frantz was appointed City Comptroller in December 2019 and elected in 2022, with his term ending December 31, 2026. He oversees the Comptroller's Office, responsible for financial reports, auditing, and record-keeping. Max also brings extensive finance experience from Amway, including roles in treasury, financial planning, and risk management.

officials.bio: John Globensky joined the City of Grand Rapids in May 2009, becoming City Treasurer in May 2014.
